text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (October 16, 2022) for 484 Drewry Avenue.

The Property Standards Committee, North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (October 16, 2022) for 484 Drewry Avenue, Folder Number: 22 217611 PRS 00 IV, and in doing so granted an extension of time to February 25, 2023. 2. Directed that the Municipal Standards Officer accept photographs for Items 1 to 4 in the Property Standards Order (October 16, 2022) for 484 Drewry Avenue, Folder Number: 22 217611 PRS 00 IV. 3. Directed that the Municipal Standards Officer conduct a site visit for Items 5 and 6 in the Property Standards Order (October 16, 2022) for 484 Drewry Avenue, Folder Number: 22 217611 PRS 00 IV, to ensure that health and safety requirements are completed.
